workers_list_failed_title: The workers could not be shown
workers_pair_description: Enter the address and code that mannie-worker pair prints on the worker's host.
workers_pair_address_description: The host's name or address, with the port when it is not 7445.
workers_pair_code_description: The code that mannie-worker pair printed. It works once, for 10 minutes.
workers_pair_name_description: The name that Mannie and its assistant use for the worker. Leave it empty to use the name in the worker's configuration.
workers_remove_description: The worker forgets this app and cancels its tasks. A worker that is offline keeps its pairing until you run mannie-worker pair --reset on its host. The conversations of its tasks stay in their parents, but can no longer be read.
workers_rename_description: Mannie and its assistant call the worker by this name. Leave it empty to use the name in the worker's configuration.
workers_error_address_invalid: Enter the host's name or address, with :port when the port is not 7445.
workers_error_unreachable: The worker could not be reached. Check the address, that the worker runs, and that the host's firewall lets this computer reach the port.
workers_error_not_a_worker: Something that is not a Mannie worker answered at this address. Check the address and the port.
workers_error_code_refused: The worker refused the code. Check it, or run mannie-worker pair on the host again for a new one: a code works once, for 10 minutes.
workers_error_too_many_attempts: The code was tried too often and no longer works. Run mannie-worker pair on the host again for a new one.
workers_error_already_paired: The worker is paired with another Mannie. Run mannie-worker pair --reset on its host, then pair it again.
workers_error_already_added: This worker is paired with this Mannie already.
workers_error_key_changed: The worker's key changed. Remove the worker, then pair it again.
workers_error_incompatible: The worker runs version {version}, which this Mannie does not work with. Update the worker on its host with mannie-worker update.
workers_error_worker_not_found: The worker is no longer paired.
workers_error_name_invalid: A worker's name has at most {maxCharacters} characters.
workers_error_name_taken: Another worker has this name. Choose a different one.
workers_error_credential_store_unavailab: The credential store, which keeps this computer's key for its workers, could not be used. Unlock it, then try again.
workers_error_storage_failed: The worker could not be saved. The log in Mannie's data folder has the cause.
workers_settings_description: The computers that run tasks for Mannie, and how they connect.
workers_settings_empty_description: A worker runs tasks for Mannie on another computer. Install mannie-worker there as a service, run mannie-worker pair on it, then pair it here.
workers_settings_update_hint: This worker needs the version of this Mannie. Update it on its host with mannie-worker update.
workers_settings_ceiling_ask: Asks before every change and command
workers_settings_ceiling_autonomous: Changes the allowed folders and runs the allowed commands without asking
workers_settings_ceiling_full_access: Changes files and runs commands anywhere on the host without asking
workers_settings_master_full_access_answ: Answers the host's requests without asking you
workers_plugin_description: Lets the conversation agent give tasks to Mannie's workers on other Windows, Linux and FreeBSD computers.

match.countPlural=one: A worker task is running. It keeps running on its worker, its approval requests wait there, and Mannie follows it again when you turn Workers back on.
match.countPlural=other: {count: number} worker tasks are running. They keep running on their workers, their approval requests wait there, and Mannie follows them again when you turn Workers back on.

workers_plugin_failure_storage_failed: Mannie could not read the paired workers. Check the log, then try again.
workers_task_detached: Mannie stopped following this task. The worker may still run it, and its conversation shows what happened since.
workers_task_read_only: This conversation belongs to a task on a worker. Its parent conversation gives it work.
workers_refusal_worker_offline: No task started: the worker {worker} is not connected.
workers_refusal_worker_unknown: No task started: no paired worker is named {worker}.
workers_refusal_worker_incompatible: No task started: the worker {worker} runs a version of Mannie that this one does not work with. Update it on its host.
workers_refusal_profile_not_reachable: No task started: the provider profile uses an address on this computer, which the worker {worker} cannot reach.
workers_refusal_still_running: No task started: the worker {worker} still works on an earlier task of this conversation.
